---
title: HTTP reference
---

A page for each group of endpoints of the backend, with a page of the error schemas. An endpoint is one
method on one path, such as `GET /api/v1/teams`. smalldocs writes these pages from the OpenAPI document
that the FastAPI app makes. OpenAPI is a standard format that describes an HTTP API. Each entry gives
the path and query parameters, their types and defaults, and a link to the line of its route in the code.

[The HTTP API page](../api.md) is written by hand. It gives an example `curl` command and a response for
each endpoint, and it explains the conventions that all the endpoints share.

| Page | Endpoints |
|---|---|
| [Reference](reference.qmd) | The lists of tournaments, seasons, teams and players for search and the filters, and the teams, opponents and results of one player |
| [Teams](teams.qmd) | A team's results, opponents, batting, bowling, fielding, partnerships and records |
| [Scope-Averages](scope-averages.qmd) | The averages of a scope, which the pages compare with a player or a team |
| [Batting](batting.qmd) | The leading batters, and one batter's figures |
| [Bowling](bowling.qmd) | The leading bowlers, and one bowler's figures |
| [Fielding](fielding.qmd) | The leading fielders, and one fielder's figures |
| [Keeping](keeping.qmd) | One wicketkeeper's figures |
| [Head to Head](head-to-head.qmd) | A batter against a bowler |
| [Matches](matches.qmd) | Matches and their scorecards |
| [Series](series.qmd) | A tournament or series, and the rivalries between teams |
| [Venues](venues.qmd) | The venues, and one venue's figures |
| [Schemas](schemas.qmd) | The shape of the error that an endpoint gives for a bad parameter |
